notes.title: KOPICS v1.2.0 released
notes.content:
[h1]Features (Home Screen)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/762a2c2219fc75dcadb0a493d68ea869ffa8d558.jpg[/img]
Improved UI layout.



[h1]Features (Creator Mode)[/h1]
Implemented the Curated Workshop and the Item Store.
You can sell your assets on the Steam Item Store now!



[h1]How to sell assets on the Steam Item Store[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/9f951f86df8b535e28dbebc139c540fe8e7f9895.jpg[/img]
Select the "Sell" button on Creator Mode.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/a9c70e37fd9ff85027aa27677b96f34ca0c24b63.jpg[/img]
Fill out the required information and click "Sell".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/e40de6d5afdb368363851539e61b81124bceefa7.jpg[/img]
Enter Payment Info


[u]Enter Contact Information[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/fea73cc3becfb6ed29847ee2b14fc2c7b6ba2c47.jpg[/img]
Enter your name, address, postal code, and phone number in alphanumeric characters.
*Bank account holder name must match bank records.


[u]Enter Payment Details[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/3a57ffa356e45a6cce704ba99d9ff9b673a2d6ab.jpg[/img]
Payee Name:		Enter the name of the bank account holder.
Payee Account Number:	Enter your bank account number.
Bank SWIFT Code:	Enter your bank identification number.
Bank Name:		Enter the bank name.
Bank Street Address~:	Enter your bank address.
Account Type:		Select your bank account type.


[u]Enter Tax Information[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/5af5558923487f7d796927ae24baf653d1c20365.jpg[/img]
Click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/f906626e0ae77573c84f9e6aadd98de387fa7333.jpg[/img]
Select "Individual / sole proprietor or single-member LLC" and select "Yes".
Enter your name, last name, and select your date of birth and country.
Click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/80ac9cba71ad0b39a3bbe9e1808b3b6cedd89d80.jpg[/img]
Enter the address in the same way as "Enter Contact Information"
Click "Continue" and the message will be displayed in red at the bottom.
Check "I received an error message stating the address input was invalid, however I confirm that the address is valid" and click "Continue" again.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/1145d0b947935967320ab473b85c54b3bae3e763.jpg[/img]
Select "Yes" for both and click "Continue".


[u]*Pattern A: Except United States[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/165c3831914d2537cda2b08af8a51fe2c9015eb1.jpg[/img]
Select "No" and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/4ca6f29d0e3a79357ede1ed25698b1251a782e2b.jpg[/img]
Check that "Individual" is entered and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/c85801a03ec6a8a359e6dcc2986eaeebf9e5c54d.jpg[/img]
Check only "None of the above apply" at the bottom and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/6ddfd48c49efc01e7ff5ce2ee10cc11a4ab95473.jpg[/img]
Make sure your country of residence is selected and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/ae04e87d42f95e390c2b20d2820bd82f4e2e4da7.jpg[/img]
Select "Yes" and enter your tax ID (TIN) in the "If you have a ~ TIN, then provide this number in the box to the right"
*Reference: https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/finance/taxfaq#2


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/bf13b6ab1282ec6156f6fad132db384ce152faad.jpg[/img]
Click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/aeeb1386a470c8c22fe0eac8c0d44a50dab2c3f9.jpg[/img]
Select "No" and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/2a1bb36f81c840899722769a4550f02bf89140b8.jpg[/img]
Check the contents of "W-8BEN" and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/d499eacf1b69e8d0c9c6d38286d6672e4ef339c6.jpg[/img]
Check all check boxes.
Enter your name in "Name of beneficial owner (or individual authorized to sign for beneficial owner)".
Enter your Steam account email address in "Email address associated with your Steam Account".
Enter "Individual" in the "Capacity in which acting" field.
Click "Submit W-8BEN" after entering all.

Tax information entry (for non-US users) is complete.


[u]*Pattern B: United States[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/b5d49caa8c7d71e9de6c683bfd9726ee0cbf665a.jpg[/img]
Select "Yes" and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/d177e609c6338c4b877fcb0b43381d214aead2f5.jpg[/img]
Select "Individual".
Enter a TIN and select whether the number corresponds to SSN or EIN.
Click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/9c878a57e90c5669c3c69df8a41c529a0a839237.jpg[/img]
Check the contents of "W-9" and click "Continue".


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/4a1921196a471dbb716d7e9ecc36800210f68b13.jpg[/img]
Check all check boxes.
Enter your name in "Signature".
Enter your Steam account email address in "Email address used to log in to your Steam Account".
Click "Submit W-9".

Tax information entry (for US users) is complete.


[u]Finalize item revenue sharing[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33290479/6a0075ed2882710ea39adaf46562c45b84f5f4e8.jpg[/img]
Click "Finalize" to publish the item to the curated workshop.
In curated workshop, users vote for items, which are then sold on the Steam item store.
60% of the sales of items sold in the store are paid to the item creator.

*KOPICS workshop revenue share (60%) may change in the future.

notes.title: HOKUSAI v1.2.5をリリースしました
notes.content:
[h1]新機能[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33290479/2624dd2e3a29776de84549413800237747d60a56.gif[/img]
素材作成ツールに[b]PSDインポート[/b]機能を実装しました。


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33290479/70a1fc8a301b2b06104df3486be255782c380e8f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33290479/ad38b911c0a2fb2e238b355b640b77f7a2254291.jpg[/img]
HOKUSAIのUIを改良しました。

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33290479/da8c3158d80fc79d621e47be34b225a5f3223a3c.jpg[/img]
新たに実績を3つ追加しました。
[list]
[*]psd画像をインポートした。
[*]ワークショップアイテムを1個お気に入りに登録した。
[*]ワークショップアイテムを100個お気に入りに登録した。(要DLC)
[/list]


[h1]HOKUSAI[/h1]
[u]変更内容[/u]
[list]
[*]データ選択画面に「チュートリアル」と「ガイド」のボタンを追加
[*]ワークショップメニューにお気に入り登録機能を追加
[*]シーン管理画面のメニューをアイコン表示に変更
[*]シーン管理画面で、リストの最後に追加ボタンを表示するように変更
[*]シーン編集画面のメニューをアイコン表示に統一
[*]シーン追加時に、選択したアセットに含まれる全てのシーンを一括で追加するように変更
[*]オプションメニューの項目を一部変更
[/list]
[u]不具合修正[/u]
[list]
[*]ワークショップアイテムを1つもサブスクライブしていないときに、登録済みアイテムのリストが正しく表示されない不具合を修正
[/list]

[h1]素材作成ツール[/h1]
[u]変更内容[/u]
[list]
[*]PSDファイルをインポートする機能を追加
[*]アイテムをドラッグ＆ドロップして並び替えやカテゴリーを変更を行う機能を追加
[*]アイテムリストにショートカットキーを追加
(Ctrl+A:全選択、Del:削除、F2:名前変更)
